context: A boss reviews a fiscal-year reporting plan
purpose: Teach: 出願/支払っ/割り当て/閣議/即座/創立/書記/税理士

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今月の閣議決定、内容把握しているか。
lines.en: Do you have a handle on this month's cabinet decision?
lines.style: Clipped, efficient opening. Direct eye contact. No warmth, no waste. The tone of someone checking boxes quickly. Slight lean forward on the question mark — expecting competence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい、即座に書記を通じて要点を整理しました。
lines.en: Yes. I had the secretary pull the key points together right away.
lines.style: Measured, matter-of-fact. Steady tempo. No over-explaining. The confidence of someone who anticipated the question and delivered before being asked. Clean, minimal.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 関連の特許出願、税理士との連携は?
lines.en: Patent filings on that — are we coordinated with the tax accountant?
lines.style: Sharp, probing. Slight emphasis on the first word. The delivery of someone digging into details. Pace quickens slightly on the second question. Not accusatory, but searching.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 割り当てに沿って、来週中に支払っ予定です。
lines.en: Per allocation, we're on track for payment by end of next week.
lines.style: Steady, factual. No hedging. Speaks with the clarity of someone who has already checked the timeline. Even pace throughout. Confident without being presumptuous.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 創立記念のイベント費用も、その流れで処理しよう。
lines.en: We'll run the founding-day event costs through the same process.
lines.style: Decisive, settling-it tone. No inflection that invites debate. The voice of someone saying this is how it will be. Brief pause before the period — gives weight to the decision.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Crisp, immediate. No hesitation. The single word delivered with the snap of professional acknowledgment. Minimal breath, maximum efficiency.
